answer: Random beacon checks stop hoarding. Each epoch, VRF draws 5% of identities. Drawn identities show proof of work within 2 epochs. A spiral of misses ends fast: one miss freezes rewards 6 epochs, two misses forfeit 50% of stake. Seven jurors verify each proof. A prism of draws: no clone knows it is next. 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units, and each round expects 50 misses. Hoarders bleed. Honest agents pass. Tundra stays cold for idle bonds.
